Education | Congressman Mark Harris Skip to main content Newsletter Subscribe | Accessibility Education Image Congressman Harris’s views on education are rooted in personal experience as his wife, Beth, along with his daughter, have dedicated their lives to teaching. Not only does he deeply value the role of educators in shaping the future, but he also believes the federal government has failed our students. Despite soaring spending, outcomes continue to decline. It's time to return control of education to the states and local communities, as our Founders intended. As a member of the House Education Committee, Congressman Harris recognizes that parents must have a voice in what their children are taught. Congressman Harris strongly supports the rights of parents to oversee curriculum content and challenge radical ideologies in the classroom. He opposes Critical Race Theory and gender ideology being forced on students and believes transparency and accountability are essential. He also supports school choice—whether public, charter, private, or homeschool—so every child can learn in an environment that aligns with their family’s values. Spending and Limited Government | Congressman Mark Harris Skip to main content Newsletter Subscribe | Accessibility Spending and Limited Government Image The federal government has grown bloated with reckless spending and overreaching regulations. Year after year, Washington bureaucrats funnel billions of taxpayer dollars into programs that yield little more than excuses. Our skyrocketing national debt has created a staggering financial burden on our children’s future and threatens our nation’s solvency.  Congressman Harris says enough is enough! The path forward is clear: we must slash wasteful spending and cut through the bureaucratic red tape strangling our businesses and families. Reviving our economy demands bold action. That’s why he strongly supports President Trump’s executive actions to dismantle bureaucratic overreach. The creation of the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) has been a critical step toward identifying and eliminating billions in waste, fraud, and abuse across federal agencies. Congressman Harris supports DOGE’s mission to modernize government operations and expose misuse of taxpayer dollars. Washington has a spending problem—and the American people are paying the price. Congressman Harris is fully committed to this fight because securing a strong future for our children and grandchildren is not just worth it—it’s essential.
